# Han Regional Variants of Funeral Custom

> Funeral Rites (Xiongli, the Rites of Mourning) / Han Regional Variants of Funeral Custom · 32 entries

Provincial units, together with the Huizhou, Minnan and Hakka sub-groups, are taken as the framework for recording regional variants of Han Chinese funeral custom.
